# T-1: Add audited retry recovery grant

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Extend retry reset into an audited recovery grant that validates --reason, computes changed evidence, writes recovery audit records, and grants exactly one re-evaluation for exhausted phases.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Invalid kind, unsupported phase, missing --yes, or short --reason returns ok:false without mutation.
- Eligible exhausted recovery writes retry-recovery.json and issue-log entries.
- Eligible exhausted recovery leaves current retry count at maxAttempts - 1.

## Implementation Notes
Owns set-retry command behavior, recovery entry/evidence/allowance classes, artifact persistence, metrics mutation, canonical phase normalization, and gate draft/spec unsupported recovery rejection. Keep existing non-exhausted reset usable but audited.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for input validation, eligible recovery, unchanged rejection, artifact shape, issue-log entry, and retry count after grant.
